STATUS. Backfilled at the hydrostat adoption from specs/001-quarrysome-promotion/ (spec, plan, tasks, research, contracts, checklists and 13 files under verdicts/). This is the closeout that stays open by standing operator decision until its work items land.

THE CAMPAIGN. The SERVICE doc tree carries a binary trust watermark: CANON (verified against code) or QUARRYSOME (attached unaudited; readers must verify before trusting). Twelve files carried QUARRYSOME at the campaign's start. Each is audited against code and terraform as ground truth, then promoted to CANON, rewritten, or deleted, with code defects found along the way carded rather than absorbed. v1 of the doc set is done when every remaining QUARRYSOME is adjudicated pending work.

MEASURED REMAINING, 2026-09-22, regenerate with `grep -rln QUARRYSOME docs/ *.md`:

- docs/dynamodb-schema-change-quarrysome.md:3 carries a watermark LEGITIMATELY. US1 adjudicated it as retained pending work, and the spec says a retained proposal keeps its watermark and filename because QUARRYSOME is the honest label for planned work not yet in code.
- docs/MODELING.md:7 is that adjudication's trust sentence ('stays QUARRYSOME until built'), not a watermark.
- SERVICE.md:14-17 is the definition block that defines the two labels, not a watermark.

So eleven of twelve are disposed of and the campaign is one audit from v1-done. Confirm that reading against verdicts/ before starting: there are 13 verdict files and this card's count is taken from the tree, not from them.

WHAT REMAINS. Audit docs/runbooks/scaling.md against code and terraform, then promote it to CANON, rewrite it, or delete it. Card any code defect the audit finds rather than fixing it here. SSE implementation work is deferred by standing owner constraint and is decided nowhere in this campaign.
